purpose: Final Phase-1 semantic-dedup candidate ledger. Research-only: production interview content is unchanged.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: Pre-release mobile build distribution and beta workflow (TestFlight/Firebase App Distribution)
addQuestionCandidates.reason: No direct interview-catalog question found. TestFlight recurs in DOU 250+, DOU 400+ and current 2026 mobile-QA interview material; current mobile interview guidance also treats TestFlight/Firebase distribution and mobile CI/CD as practical knowledge.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical question about getting the correct pre-release build to testers, build/version identity, tester/device access, signing/provisioning constraints, feedback/crash evidence and CI distribution. Keep TestFlight as a concrete iOS example rather than creating several vendor questions.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: HTTP/HTTPS traffic interception and proxy debugging for client applications
addQuestionCandidates.reason: No direct interview-catalog question found. DOU 250+/400+ and current mobile QA material repeatedly mention sniffers or Charles/Proxyman/Fiddler-style debugging; GimmeJob currently teaches proxies in testing-tools content but does not ask the interview intent directly.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical question about configuring an intercepting proxy, inspecting requests/responses, reproducing network failures, certificates/trust, HTTPS limitations such as pinning, and separating client, network and backend evidence. Use official/security documentation later to validate the answer.

addQuestionCandidates.reason: DOU 250+ contains baseline Git questions; DOU 400+ adds conflicts, fetch/pull and cherry-pick; current 2026 QA/SDET interview sources explicitly ask daily workflow, merge/rebase, conflict resolution, PR review and CI integration. No direct authored GimmeJob interview question covers the workflow end to end.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical workflow question: branch -> change -> commit -> sync -> merge/rebase decision -> resolve conflicts -> PR/review -> CI. Fold fetch/pull/cherry-pick/reset/revert into follow-ups instead of creating command-by-command trivia.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: Testing WebSocket and real-time bidirectional features
addQuestionCandidates.reason: DOU 400+ asks WebSocket/socket questions and current 2026 technical interview sources independently emphasize WebSocket lifecycle, async messages, reconnect, ordering and delivery behavior. Repo-wide search found WebSocket material in learning content but no direct authored QA interview question in the main interview catalog.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical Middle/Senior question covering handshake/authentication, connection lifecycle, messages in both directions, reconnect/backoff, duplicate/missed/out-of-order messages, permissions, multiple clients and useful diagnostics. Do not duplicate generic messaging contract/replay questions already present.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: Mobile offline operation, reconnect and synchronization/conflict handling
addQuestionCandidates.reason: Current 2026 mobile-QA interview sources explicitly ask how to test an app offline and synchronize when connectivity returns. Existing push-notification coverage mentions offline recovery but does not test general local writes, queued actions, resync, duplication, stale data and conflicts as the primary interview intent.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One scenario question: start online -> lose/poor network -> perform reads/writes offline -> background/kill/restart where relevant -> reconnect -> verify retries, ordering, idempotency, conflict policy, stale-state UX and no data loss/duplication.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: Mobile app upgrade and local-state/data migration testing
addQuestionCandidates.reason: DOU 400+ includes local data migration, and current 2026 mobile QA material treats install-over-old-version, retained sessions/preferences and on-device schema migration as a distinct real-world risk. No direct authored GimmeJob mobile interview question was found for upgrade-path preservation.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical question comparing clean install with upgrade paths. Seed representative state on older supported versions, install the new build, verify migration/data/session/settings, interrupted/failed migration behavior, compatibility and launch stability.

addQuestionCandidates.reason: GimmeJob has shift-left in learning content, taxonomy and requirement-review tags, but no direct interview question. Multiple current 2026 QA/SDET banks ask it explicitly and evaluate concrete process changes rather than the definition alone.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One Middle-level strategy question covering refinement/three-amigos, testability/design review, component/contract checks, static analysis and fast PR feedback, while preserving whole-team ownership and avoiding the simplistic answer 'move tests earlier'.

addQuestionCandidates.concept: Choosing an automation framework/tool for a product and team
addQuestionCandidates.reason: The catalog has a direct question about framework components, but not the distinct decision intent of choosing Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or another approach. Current 2026 QA automation interview sources ask the comparison/selection question explicitly.
addQuestionCandidates.shape: One practical decision question based on product/browser/platform needs, team languages/skills, debugging and auto-waiting model, parallelism, CI infrastructure, ecosystem, maintainability, migration cost and total ownership cost. Avoid declaring one framework universally best.
